name: Rebulk
long_description:
Rebulk builds AI-native software for railroads, transload terminals, bulk trucking companies, industrial plants, and commodity merchants.

Our products span transportation and transload management, rail and yard operations, maintenance, inventory management, CRM, and ERP. We also combine computer vision, LiDAR, edge computing, and integrations with industrial equipment to automate data collection from physical operations.

Much of this industry still relies on spreadsheets, paperwork, manual data entry, and disconnected legacy systems. Teams spend hours on repetitive administrative work, tracking down information, and coordinating operations across different systems. Rebulk brings these workflows together, automates manual processes, and gives businesses real-time visibility into their operations.

We’ve lived this problem, and we know how to build for it. Warren previously led product at a Series A supply chain software startup, where he worked closely with companies moving and managing bulk commodities. Cole was engineer #3 at Tropic, helping scale it from seed to Series B, and later led engineering at an AI startup.
one_liner: AI-native software for managing rail and bulk operations.
